sentences.text:
Petitioners are lugged and locked in F.I.R No.111/2024 of Police Station Sahawa, District Churu,
for the offence under Section(s) 376(2)(N) of the I.P.C. and under Sections 70(1), 123 of BNS.
They have filed these applications for restoration of liberty under section 483 of BNSS (Section 439 of the old Code).

2. Heard arguments advanced by learned counsel for the petitioners, learned public prosecutor and Ramswaroop vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:41194) on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58734478/
1 carefully perused the entire material available on record.
3.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has strongly objected the different submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioners.
He thus, craves rejection of the petitioners' bail applications.
4. I have given my anxious consideration to the rival submissions with reference to material placed before me.
5. On perusal of the record, it would be clear that victim is a major female.
Admittedly, she was having a love affair with principal accused Manish and eloped with her.

As per her statement recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C. she stated nothing against both the petitioners but in statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. a casual narration of rape has been made against the petitioners also, besides principal accused-Manish.
Charge-sheet has already been filed after investigation.

6. Having considered the material available on record; the arguments advanced by counsel for the petitioners particularly the facts narrated above and the fact that trial is likely to take its own considerable time and taking note of all these aspects, I do not intend to go into the merits of the matter but of the considered view that the petitioners have available to them substantial grounds so as to question the prosecution case and no useful purpose would be served by keeping the petitioners in detention [2024:RJ-JD:41194] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-10518/2024] for an indefinite period therefore, I am inclined to grant indulgence of bail to the petitioners at this stage.

7. Consequently, the present bail applications are allowed and it is directed that the accused-petitioners Ramswaroop S/o Ramlal and Hawa Singh S/o Deepa Ram arrested in connection with the F.I.R. No. 111/2024 of Police Station Sahawa, District Churu shall be released on bail provided each of them furnish a personal bond and two surety bonds of sufficient amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

This order is subject to the condition that accused,
within 7 days of their release, and sureties on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts, with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as copy of front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 44-45-minki/-
